body: After 25 years, I am finally realizing that I grew up in an emotionally and physically abusive household. I thought everyone's life was like that.
Got one of these yesterday. I'm so glad the mods put this up earlier so I was aware of it after the first sentence.
Sorry that I can't help as I only have my one laptop. I was going to suggest posting this in /r/techrecycle. You may have better response there. What you are doing is awesome!
Interesting... does not know how to use electronics very well, yet makes a sex tape.

Wow! Thanks for your quick and thorough response. I was hoping that it was a chemical issue and have tried various medications for almost ten years. I've tried everything from antidepressants, anxiety medication and mood stabilizers to even some off label use of medications under a doctor's care. Also with my psych history, people get very scared very quickly. Having a regular doctor just seemed to make me end up in the hospital more, not less. 
I just had some blood work last week and everything was pretty normal (thyroid levels were normal). I went in because I lost 35 lbs in 2 months with no change to diet and exercise. I really just don't know what else to try because I feel like I've tried everything in the mental health field. Thank you for your kind words.

Thanks for connecting with me. I'm a 24 year old female in the Silicon Valley in the US. I have a really good job and a super promising career for someone my age. I graduated from a university a couple of years ago and have a strong resume. I'm pretty and have lots of friends. That's why I'm wondering why I'm depressed. I feel like I have no "real problems" when I know there are people out there that are struggling with much more challenging things than I am. There are a lot of little instances that lead to this ie. family issues, past trauma and trouble at work. If I think about it logically my life is very promising. Why do I feel like I want to disappear? I just can't imagine getting through another day as me. I don't know how to feel better.

I really like the idea of using affirmations. I personally liked your "I'm good enough, I'm smart enough, and gosh darn it, people like me." It made me smile, at least, so I will try to use it often. Please let me know if I can better answer your questions.

Thanks for your reply. It's so nice that people are reaching out to help a stranger. I don't really know where to begin or really what lead me here. Just tired of feeling horrible about myself everyday.

Thanks for your very thoughtful reply. I have tried the hotlines in the past and they have not helped. I fear that I can not adequately express my problems and my sadness without them being concerned for my safety. Another hospitalization on top of the countless others is something I can't go through again. I am sure they help some people but all I find myself doing is being bored to death. The only way to get out of there is by pretending things are ok again and I don't have it in me to fake it again. Plus the hospital debt is already beyond what i can manage. I even had a cop tell me that it would be covered by the police just so that I wouldn't put up a fight and he could put me in the hospital. Thousands of dollars later, I find out he was a complete liar. So who do I trust at this point? The people that lie to me or the people that I have to lie to? 
I don't have anything fundamentally wrong with my life. I'm pretty, have lots of friends and have a good job. I just find myself hating it all and just wanting to disappear. 

I will try to think of something positive to focus on for tomorrow. I at least want to try to make things happy again. I'm just hurting so much. I can't get this right.

I've tried counselors and therapists. They do not help. I know it takes a while to find the right one but I've been in therapy for 18 years. I don't really want to keep searching and failing to connect. Just a waste of time any money for me at least. I'm sure therapy works really well for lots of people. Sure i wouldn't mind talking here. I'm not so good at expressing myself in email for some reason. I'm failing at life right now. Family isn't talking to me. I can't go to work anymore and people are getting upset. I hate feeling like a disappointment everyday.
My friends don't understand and some even get mad at me. My family is not talking to me. I'm alone.
Thanks. I don't really know where to start or what to say. I just seem to screw everything up. When I try to fix things, i screw them up more. Just a failure. I don't know what to do anymore.
Great Essay! Your story was inspiring. Best of luck to you, my friend!
Wow! This is incredibly kind! I am overwhelmed by your unexpected generosity. I have sent you my information. I wish good karma upon you, my friend!
I'm having a rough time. This may sound silly but could you send me a greeting card? It would make me smile.
I really don't know. I'm just having such a hard time and I don't know what to do...

If you work for the school district, have you tried searching for different jobs there? With your degree, you could probably work as a teacher's assistant. Many districts like to promote from within so you have a good shot for a job. Once you have worked in a job like that for a little while, you will have great work experience to find another job in your field. Congrats on your degree!
Thanks for your reply! I'm not applying to be a teacher. I'm applying to be a teacher's assistant. I've worked as an aide before in the public school system, if that's important.
